data.title: 萝丝 · 王城露台的加冕宣誓
data.description: 奥利安娜王宫宏伟的圣殿露台上。晨钟回荡，千万白鸽飞跃王都。萝丝头戴金冠，一手按在胸前，向广阔广场上的臣民俯身致敬，曾经的迷茫退去，眼眸中闪烁着斩断苦难的坚毅王者威光。
data.location: grand royal palace balcony overlooking a vast fantasy kingdom square filled with banners and flying white doves
data.action: standing at the edge of the stone parapet, one hand over her heart while waving gently with the other, crowned head held high with resolute regal pride
data.lighting: brilliant morning sunlight bathing the palace white marble and golden ornaments
data.mood: magnificent royal ascension, sovereign resolve, liberation from tragedy
data.promptProse: Rose as a crowned queen stands on the palace balcony in white gold coronation robes, hand on heart looking out with majestic resolve.
data.animaCaption: Waving to the cheering kingdom from the sunlit palace balcony in coronation regalia.
